Examples.Title: Get Config
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Loud.Technology.Airflow.Sdk;` is in scope and a configured credential environment variable is set: `AIRFLOW_API_TOKEN`.

Examples.Title: Get Config Value
Examples.Code:
### Get Config Value
# @name get_config_value
GET {{host}}/api/v2/config/section/{{section}}/option/{{option}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
accept: */*
Accept: application/json, text/plain

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful Response
# Content-Type: application/json, text/plain
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Forbidden
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not Found
# Content-Type: application/json
# 406
# Description: Not Acceptable
# Content-Type: application/json
# 422
# Description: Validation Error
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Experimental: Wait for a dag run to complete, and return task results if requested.
Examples.Description: 🚧 This is an experimental endpoint and may change or be removed without notice.Successful response are streamed as newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON). Each line is a JSON object representing the DAG run state.
Examples.Code:
### Experimental: Wait for a dag run to complete, and return task results if requested.
# @name wait_dag_run_until_finished
GET {{host}}/api/v2/dags/{{dag_id}}/dagRuns/{{dag_run_id}}/wait?interval={{interval}}&result={{result}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
Accept: application/json, application/x-ndjson

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful Response
# Content-Type: application/json, application/x-ndjson
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Forbidden
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not Found
# Content-Type: application/json
# 422
# Description: Validation Error
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Get Dag Source
Examples.Description: Get source code using file token.
Examples.Code:
### Get Dag Source
# @name get_dag_source
GET {{host}}/api/v2/dagSources/{{dag_id}}?version_number={{version_number}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
accept: */*
Accept: application/json, text/plain

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful Response
# Content-Type: application/json, text/plain
# 400
# Description: Bad Request
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Forbidden
# Content-Type: application/json

# 422
# Description: Validation Error

Examples.Title: Get Log
Examples.Description: Get logs for a specific task instance.
Examples.Code:
### Get Log
# @name get_log
GET {{host}}/api/v2/dags/{{dag_id}}/dagRuns/{{dag_run_id}}/taskInstances/{{task_id}}/logs/{{try_number}}?full_content=false&map_index=-1&token={{token}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
accept: */*
Accept: application/json, application/x-ndjson

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful Response
# Content-Type: application/json, application/x-ndjson
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Forbidden
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not Found
# Content-Type: application/json
# 422
# Description: Validation Error
# Content-Type: application/json
